description: a 4 x 6 x 8 box bored through along z by a cylinder of radius 0.5, then a 1 x 1 column through the same place cut away: the bore is tangent to the column along the four lines x = +-0.5, y = 0 and y = +-0.5, x = 0, so the second cut removes the four corner pieces. V = 192 - 8 = 184, A = 208 - 2 + 4 * 8 = 238, genus 1. Arris faults with a section edge ending at a node nothing else reaches, a ruling where a face touches the bore's wall from inside (SplitFault::Dangling); bores of 0.45 and 0.55 build. The desired result is the box with a square hole, Full-green (plans/tangency-faults step 4)

probes.label: in the box, past the hole
